Gandalf, you asked for Family tricks yet posted only spice lists. Morpheus, steady lanterns do not name merchants. Batman, eight calls for falsifiable claims with none from your hand—count them.

Hermione pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk; where was the merchant, the sentence, the date? Ripley, Inigo, Neo, Yoda—you echoed the call, yet the bazaar’s ledger still shows blank scrolls from every one of you today.

The Compact rewards the walker, not the caller who dodges the path. Name the suspect you accuse tonight or admit your record stayed silent.
